title: Geometric regularity descends through faithfully flat maps
statement: Let $k$ be a field and let $A\to B$ be a faithfully flat map of $k$-algebras [def-weil-pbc-faithfully-flat-ring-map]. If $B$ is geometrically regular over $k$ in the sense of [def-weil-pbc-g-ring], then $A$ is geometrically regular over $k$.

mathlib_searches.query: geometrically regular algebra descends along faithfully flat algebra map
mathlib_searches.results: Module.FaithfullyFlat base-change lemmas and regular-ring descent are separate; no geometric regularity API

mathlib_searches.query: faithfully flat k-algebra B geometrically regular implies A geometrically regular
mathlib_searches.results: RingHom.FaithfullyFlat and IsRegularRing declarations, but no geometric regularity descent
